water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, agriculture
water_need.quote: Further irrigations at intervals of 7 - 10 and 10 - 15 days during summer and winter season respectively
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering every 7-10 days or less is read as 'low', every few days as 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

source_notes: AI research batch 7 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table; other values are from TNAU/NHB (Tamil Nadu and national) until a local source is found.
